title: ExamLeaf Packaging Profile v2
description: Registry kind packaging/ (proposed; see subsystems/PACKAGING_and_DISTRIBUTION_REGISTRY.md). A packaging profile says how an approved artefact is encoded, captioned, titled, disclosed and described for one channel. Bytes-affecting fields (encode, burned captions) are pinned in the EPP as packaging/<id>@x.y.z#render, whose value is the SHA-256 of {render_variant, loudness, captions.max_lines, safe_zone}; copy and sidecar fields are pinned in the Distribution Package record, so a metadata change re-exports without reopening the full-watch gate. The neutral metadata sidecar is defined in #/definitions/metadata_sidecar. FORBIDDEN FIELDS (documentation only; additionalProperties:false makes them structurally impossible and the commercial-term lint rejects them by name in every pipeline file): (1) the CE-26 regex family: price, pricing, paid, is_free, free_*, premium, entitle*, subscri*, sku, paywall, unlock, monetis*, monetiz*, revenue, discount, coupon; (2) any field name containing 'tier' (for example the v1 ShortSpec access_tier); (3) v1 commercial routing and funnel fields: destination_resource_id, funnel_objective, cta_destination, purchase_*, checkout_*, product_id, bundle_*, offer_*, trial_*, book_activation, activation_code and any activation secret; (4) advertising and growth analytics: ads_*, ad_targeting, advert*, campaign_*, utm_*, affiliate_*, conversion_*, experiment_id, experiment_arm, virality_score, brain_activity; (5) learner data: student_name, learner_id, email, phone, school, handle, any learner submission; (6) secrets and transient access: api_key, access_token, auth_token, playback_token, signed_url, secret, password (design 'tokens' such as safe-zone token files are not secrets and are allowed). Entitlement, pricing, playback tokens and analytics are joined by the platform outside the pipeline (CE-L1, RD-49).
$comment: Commercial-term lint (CE-L1/RD-49): CI rejects, case-insensitively, any match of (price|pricing|paid|is_free|free_|premium|entitle|subscri|sku|paywall|unlock|monetis|monetiz|revenue|discount|coupon|tier|destination_resource|cta_destination|funnel|purchase_|checkout_|product_id|offer_|trial_|utm_|campaign_|affiliate_|activation_code|storefront) applied to every object key at every depth (including REN fields keys), every required entry, pattern key and enum or const value (updated 15 Oct 2026, safety-13). Editorial fields series_position, flagship and demo_kind are exempt. Measured quantities are decimal strings with units (CE-32). 15 Oct 2026 (stitch): interaction_sidecar and file role interactions_json added (interaction-01); export_qa holds the packaging-11 unconditional set plus Q-META.interactions_sidecar and Q-RIGHTS.scope, and video profiles add A11.package, A4.platform and Q-A11Y.captions; ac0 sidecars carry no next_step description block (safety-08); binding.approvals also requires VOICE (safety-01); pins keys follow resolver-13 without gs/ and reviewer/.

registry_pin_key.description: Registry pin key (15 Oct 2026, resolver-13): the EPP pin kinds of schemas/epp.schema.json except packaging (pinned only as its bytes half, packaging/<id>@x.y.z#render) and gs (recorded on the voice entry, never pinned; resolver-08); reviewer/ is never a pin (resolver-14). Optional #variant as persona/<id>@x.y.z#<variant>.

verify_value.description: A platform figure that is not in the verified evidence. It stays null until measured or confirmed from the platform's current documentation, with the source recorded.

metadata_sidecar.description: Neutral metadata sidecar (export/sidecar.json) written by the neutral exporter at S14 after RELEASE-CHECK. It carries ids, competency GUIDs, level, format, locale, versions, hashes, audience safety class, accessibility tracks, disclosure and provenance only. Every forbidden field listed in the top-level description is absent by construction.

packaging_profile_sha256.description: SHA-256 (CE-32 canon) of the whole packaging profile this package was exported under.

release_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the signed release manifest the release service writes at S13 (07/06 §6.3). The manifest never contains package_sha256, so there is no cycle.

pins.description: Every registry pin@version in the closure mapped to its SHA-256. The packaging profile appears only as its bytes half, packaging/<id>@x.y.z#render (SHA-256 of {render_variant, loudness, captions.max_lines, safe_zone}); the whole-profile hash is binding.packaging_profile_sha256 (15 Oct 2026).

hashtags.description: Approved hashtags for this locale (PACKAGING §4.6). Uploaded exactly as listed; nothing is added at upload.

copy_sha256.description: SHA-256 (CE-32 canon) of {locale, title, cover_text, description_blocks, hashtags, cover image sha256}. The COPY approval binds this hash.

copy_approval_id.description: approval_id of the COPY entry in binding.approvals whose bound_sha256 equals copy_sha256 (recorded at S12).

text_ref.description: The pinned voice/ entry's disclosure.text_ref for classification.locale. Q-DISC.script checks ai_voice_disclosure byte for byte against it.

disclosure.$comment: 15 Oct 2026: the English wording patterns were removed. The text is owned once by the voice/ entry (VOICE §3.9) per locale; Q-DISC.script checks it byte for byte. The schema checks that variant, voice path and performer_credit agree. A mixed (F16) variant waits on O-5.

supersedes_package_id.description: The released package (same artefact_id and packaging_profile) that this corrected package replaces (07/06 §8).

interaction_sidecar.description: Neutral interaction sidecar (export/interactions.json, file role interactions_json) written by the neutral exporter at S14 from the approved Interaction Spec and the measured final timeline (15 Oct 2026). Ids, times, item content and keys only; no learner data and no commercial field. AC0 behaviour is carried by audience_class and mapped by the platform (CE-17).

key.description: Verbatim copy of the ASM key fields; no tolerance field (registry §10 enumerates equivalent forms).

allOf.$comment: 15 Oct 2026 (level-3+, CE-120): option_labels copied verbatim from the Interaction Spec; required when the key has options or the item presents choices.

publish_receipt.description: Publish receipt content/packages/PKG-<id>.publish.<channel>.json, written by the publisher per channel after S14 and before the item is public. Q-DISC.placement reads it; it is never inside the sidecar (15 Oct 2026).

x_kind_note.$comment: 15 Oct 2026 (Architecture §3.4 R8): a property carrying "x-kind": "limit" is a limit; R8(a) takes the most restrictive value across safety class, a11y profile, level, overlay, format, locale and style. Annotation only; validators ignore it.

option_label.description: Keyboard key and screen-reader label for one ASM option (level-3+, CE-120, 15 Oct 2026). The label gives the option text and position only and never marks the key (answer protection; Q-A11Y.asm_labels).

option_id.description: The ASM option_id (mcq), left item (match, diagram_label) or sequence element (ordering).

render_target.$comment: 15 Oct 2026 (level-3+, CE-119): print = a tagged PDF/UA plus an HTML twin from the same Format Plan through the pinned Chrome print path (packaging/print-pdf).

render_variant.description: Bytes-affecting fields; pinned in the EPP. A change is a Presentational or Render-toolchain class change.

print_variant.description: Bytes half of a print profile (level-3+, CE-119, 15 Oct 2026): pinned in the EPP as packaging/<id>@x.y.z#render, the SHA-256 of {print_variant}. Replaces render_variant, loudness and captions, which a print profile does not carry.

file_size_limit.description: Per-file size ceiling for low-bandwidth use; a value to verify, never assumed (Q-META.size).

loudness_test_variant_allowed.description: Only the AD-04 Reels loudness A/B test may use -14 LUFS (house true-peak ceiling still applies); never for safety/ac0.

loudness.$comment: Values owned by MUSIC_and_SOUND_REGISTRY.md policy 6; the AD-04 -14 LUFS arm is the 12/04 reels_test_variant token, allowed only by loudness_test_variant_allowed (instagram_reels only; never ac0). The test arm is a separate rendition, never the house master (15 Oct 2026).

allOf.$comment: 15 Oct 2026 (level-3+, CE-119): a print profile carries print_variant and no render_variant, loudness or captions; aspects ['none'] and no chapters; its export QA adds Q-A11Y.print_structure and Q-META.size. Every other profile carries render_variant, loudness, captions, safe_zone and disclosure, and its export QA includes A9.package and Q-META.interactions_sidecar (moved here from the unconditional list).
